title: EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT dated November 10, 2026, relative to the Official Police
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT dated November 10, 2026, relative to the Official Police
  Garage Towing and Storage Rates for 2027, as set forth.  [BPC #26-342]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Executive Director’s report.
summary: The Board of Police Commissioners is asked to approve the garage towing and storage rates for 2027 set out in the Executive Director's report.
